title: Pricing Strata Mapper & Attribution Fabric — token-level cost analytics flow
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: design an interaction model and visual language for token-level cost analytics (Cost Strata) that supports multi-dimensional attribution, role-aware export templates, and pricing patterns for tiered/unit-based billing. The deliverable is a high-fidelity Figma prototype + an interactive export wizard spec that ops and billing teams can use when creating invoices or CSV feeds.

Context: PMs and Finance want an actionable view that surfaces how tokens map to pricing slabs, SKU tags, model variants, and routes. Engineers require a predictable payload for CSV/JSON exports and clear UX constraints so batching/caching heuristics can be surfaced without confusing customers.

Scope: 1) Cost Strata main panel (aggregate + breakout rows), 2) Attribution Fabric (ability to pivot by route, model, user/team, prompt tag), 3) Export Wizard (CSV templates, columns mapping, role-based presets), 4) Pricing Pattern playground (simulate tiered slabs, overage calc, unit rounding preview).

Non-goals: billing engine implementation, backend schema changes (we will surface existing endpoints), deep dive into currency localization (handled by separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype demonstrates primary flows: pivot by dimension, drill from aggregate to invocation, and launch export with selected template
Export spec documents required CSV fields, sample JSON payload used by analytics pipeline, and access permissions per role
Design handoff includes component tokens and a compact responsive layout for consoles with >3 columns of data
UX patterns for pricing simulations are documented including edge-case behavior (rounding, mixed-model invoices, fallback rates)
